name: Cephilith Novitiate
description: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.

abilities.name: Minion (12)
abilities.description: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: Sacrifice Self
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.
